no_pe.name: Negative PE Screen
no_pe.description: Wells score & PERC rule evaluation for pulmonary embolism
no_pe.replacement:
• [No] cough / hemoptysis
• [No] recent travel, surgery, or immobilization
• [No] prior history of VTE / DVT / PE
• [No] unilateral leg swelling / erythema
--> Wells score: [ 0 ], PERC rule: [ Negative / Rule-out PE ]

norm_card.name: Normal Cardiac Exam
norm_card.replacement: S1/S2 normal, regular rate and rhythm. No murmurs, rubs, or gallops. Peripheral pulses 2+ bilaterally. JVP [ flat / <3cm above sternal angle ]. No peripheral edema.

norm_resp.name: Normal Respiratory Exam
norm_resp.replacement: Lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally. Normal vesicular breath sounds. No wheezes, crackles, or pleural friction rubs. Normal work of breathing on [ room air ].

norm_neuro.name: Normal Neurological Exam
norm_neuro.replacement: Alert and oriented x3. GCS [ 15 ]. Cranial nerves II-XII grossly intact. Motor strength 5/5 in all four extremities. Sensation intact to light touch. Gait steady, cerebellar testing intact.

norm_gi.name: Normal Abdominal Exam
norm_gi.replacement: Abdomen soft, non-distended, non-tender to palpation throughout. Bowel sounds present in all four quadrants. No guarding, rigidity, rebound tenderness, or organomegaly.

hfref_plan.name: Heart Failure (HFrEF) Plan
hfref_plan.description: Acute decompensated heart failure management bundle
hfref_plan.replacement:
# Acute Decompensated Heart Failure (HFrEF)
- Lasix [ 40 ] mg IV [ BID / daily ]
- Fluid restrict to [ 1.5 ] L/day, strict I/O, daily morning weights
- Target euvolemia; hold ACEi/ARB/ARNI if SBP < [ 100 ]
- Transthoracic echocardiogram [ ordered / pending ]
- Monitor electrolytes, BUN, and Creatinine daily

copd_plan.name: COPD Exacerbation Plan
copd_plan.replacement:
# Acute Exacerbation of COPD (AECOPD)
- Prednisone [ 50 ] mg PO daily x 5 days
- Ventolin [ 2.5 ] mg / Atrovent [ 500 ] mcg neb q4h PRN
- Antibiotics: [ Azithromycin 500mg daily / Ceftriaxone 1g IV daily ]
- Titrate supplemental O2 to target SpO2 [ 88-92% ]
- Chest X-ray and sputum culture [ pending ]
